items.description: The University of Colorado at Colorado Springs is offering a fully funded PhD student position in AI for biomedical engineering, available in Spring or Fall 2027. Location: United States Deadline: 2027-10-01 Hiring Organization: University of Colorado at Colorado Springs The H-Lab at the University of Colorado at Colorado Springs (UCCS) is recruiting a PhD student to help build AI systems for biomedical engineering and informatics. The successful candidate will have access to deep-learning machines and high-performance computing clusters with hundreds of GPUs, as well as opportunities to collaborate with the medical device industry and prestigious medical centers. Research topics include algorithms development, image processing, computer vision, computational photography, finite element modeling, machine learning, deep learning, large language models, and open-source software development. The candidate will work under the supervision of Dr. Yu (Andy) Huang, Assistant Professor of Computer Science. Applicants should have a Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in a related area, good programming knowledge, and fluent English. Prior research experience and knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, and biomedical signal/image processing are desirable. To apply, interested candidates should submit their application via the department website by October 1st for Spring admission or February 1st for Fall admission. Applicants should also send their CV and unofficial transcript to Dr. Huang at yhuang6@uccs.edu . Tags: AI, biomedical engineering, PhD position, machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, University of Colorado at Colorado Springs, United States

Location: Germany Deadline: 2026-09-18 Hiring Organization: Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich A postdoctoral position in Machine Learning, Dynamical Systems, and Control is available at the Institute of Informatics, University of Munich (LMU), Germany. Candidates should have a strong background in computer science and mathematics, with specialization in machine learning, dynamical systems, and/or control theory. Research topics of interest include dynamical systems theory for ML, Koopman operator theory, ML-based control, model-predictive control, neural ODEs, physics-informed ML, reinforcement learning, representation learning, and uncertainty quantification. To apply, please upload an electronic version of your application in a single PDF file to https://prairie-sleet-329.notion.site/33b07389f5c380d7ad17daff8d0a7350 . items.description: The University of Surrey is pleased to announce three open academic positions in Artificial Intelligence, seeking internationally recognised researchers to strengthen its research and teaching in this field. Location: United Kingdom Deadline: 2026-09-13 Hiring Organization: University of Surrey Three open academic positions are available: Professor in Artificial Intelligence, Senior Lecturer in Artificial Intelligence, and Professor in Artificial Intelligence (Centre for Vision, Speech and Signal Processing). These appointments form part of a wider recruitment campaign and strategic investment across the Faculty. The Professor and Senior Lecturer positions in Computer Science cover areas including Large Machine Learning Models, Neurosymbolic AI, Trustworthy Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and applications of AI and machine learning in automated reasoning, security, and software and systems development. For more information and to apply, please visit the following links: Professor in Artificial Intelligence (NICE Research Group) , Senior Lecturer in Artificial Intelligence (NICE Research Group) , and Professor in Artificial Intelligence (Centre for Vision, Speech and Signal Processing) . Informal enquiries concerning the Computer Science positions may be directed to Professor Brijesh Dongol at b.dongol@surrey.ac.uk . Enquiries concerning the CVSSP position may be directed to Professor Adrian Hilton at a.hilton@surrey.ac.uk .
